title: FastAPI
explain: FastAPI turns Python functions into web endpoints with very little code. A decorator like `@app.get` connects a URL to a function, and type hints become automatic input validation. It also generates interactive docs at `/docs`.
exercise: Install `fastapi` and `uvicorn`, run `uvicorn main:app --reload`, then open `/square/7` and `/docs`. Add a `/greet/{name}` route.
tip: Forgetting the type hint on a path parameter makes FastAPI treat it as a string. Add `n: int` to get validation for free.
